metaDescription: How to spot rental scams in Georgia, safety tips for guests and owners, how {siteName} verifies listings, what to do if something goes wrong, and current scam alerts.

hero.title: Stay safe when you rent, buy or host
hero.lead: Most people are honest. These tips help you spot the few who are not — before you send any money.

goldenRule.title: The golden rule
goldenRule.body: Never pay before you've checked the owner and seen the place — in person or on a live video call.
goldenRule.noLinks: {siteName} will never send you a payment link in a chat.

alerts.title: Current scam alerts
alerts.lead: Warnings from our team about scams we are seeing right now.
alerts.emptyBody: When we see a new kind of scam, we post a warning here. Until then, the tips below protect you from the most common ones.
alerts.errorBody: Please try again in a few minutes. The safety tips below still apply.

spot.title: How to spot a scam
spot.lead: Be careful if you see any of these signs. One alone may be innocent; two or more are a warning.

deposit.title: A deposit before you've seen the place
deposit.body: The “owner” asks for a deposit or the full rent before a viewing or a video call.

abroad.title: “I'm abroad, I'll post you the keys”
abroad.body: The owner can't meet you and offers to send the keys by courier once you pay.

paymentLinks.title: Payment links in a chat
paymentLinks.body: A link to a “secure payment”, a “booking confirmation” or a copy of a well-known website, sent on WhatsApp, Telegram or by email.

untraceable.title: Western Union, gift cards or crypto
untraceable.body: A request to pay in a way that can't be traced or reversed: money-transfer services, gift cards or cryptocurrency.

lowPrice.title: A price far below the area
lowPrice.body: A large, central apartment for much less than similar places nearby. If it looks too good to be true, it usually is.

pressure.title: Pressure to decide fast
pressure.body: “Lots of people want it — pay today or I'll give it to someone else.” Scammers don't want you to have time to check.

offPlatform.title: Moving somewhere else to pay
offPlatform.body: A request to continue on another site or app to “complete the booking” or pay. {siteName} doesn't take bookings or payments.

report.title: Seen one of these signs?
report.body: Tell us. Your report protects the next person too.

guests.title: Tips for guests and buyers
guests.tip1: Never pay before you've checked the owner and seen the place, in person or on a live video call.
guests.tip2: Don't send money by bank transfer, Bit, PayBox, crypto or gift cards to someone you haven't verified.
guests.tip3: {siteName} will never send you a payment link in a chat.
guests.tip4: Look for verification badges and a recent “Last updated” date on the listing.
guests.tip5: Keep the conversation somewhere you can find it later, and note the listing ID.
guests.tip6: Buying property? Check the Public Registry extract and use your own lawyer before you pay anything.

video.title: The video-call check
video.body: Ask the owner for a short live video call. Ask them to walk through the apartment and to show a paper with today's date and the listing ID. A real owner can do it in two minutes; a scammer usually can't.

overpayment.title: Fake overpayments
overpayment.body: A “guest” pays more than the price and asks you to “please refund the difference”. The original payment is cancelled later — and your refund is gone.

screenshots.title: Fake payment screenshots
screenshots.body: A screenshot is not a payment. Check your own bank account or app before you hand over keys or confirm dates.

codes.title: Never share codes sent to your phone
codes.body: No one from {siteName}, from a bank or a guest needs the codes sent to you by SMS or WhatsApp. Anyone who asks is trying to take over your account.

commands.title: Never run commands or install anything a “guest” sends
commands.body: A real guest never needs you to install software, open a file or paste a command. This is how hotel accounts were taken over.

captcha.title: Fake “I'm not a robot” pages
captcha.body: A page that asks you to press keys or paste something into “Run” or a terminal to “prove you're human” is a trick. Close it.

sharing.title: Don't share your account
sharing.body: Everyone signs in with their own account. Never give anyone your login or your codes, not even a “helper” or a management company.

verification.title: How verification works
verification.lead: Owners earn badges by proving who they are, and every listing goes through automatic checks.
verification.checksTitle: Automatic checks on every new or edited listing
verification.checksLead: Each listing gets a risk score. Low-risk listings go live; higher-risk ones wait for a person.

checks.photos: Photos already used in another listing or account
checks.price: A price far below the usual price for the area and size
checks.phrases: Scam phrases in all five languages, such as “send the deposit first”
checks.contacts: Phone numbers or links hidden in the text or the photos
checks.accounts: A new account posting many listings fast, several accounts on one device, or virtual phone numbers
checks.firstListing: The first listing from every account is always reviewed by a person

phone.label: Phone verified
phone.body: Confirmed their phone number with a code. Required to post.

id.label: ID verified
id.body: Sent an ID document and a selfie, checked by hand by our team.

owner.label: Owner verified
owner.body: Proved they own the property or may rent it out — in Georgia, with a Public Registry (NAPR) extract.

property.label: Property verified
property.body: A live video call with our team, or a visit from a local representative.

help.title: If something goes wrong
help.lead: Act quickly. The sooner you tell us, the more we can do — for you and for the next person.

step1.title: Stop paying
step1.body: Don't send any more money, even if you're promised a refund.

step2.title: Keep the evidence
step2.body: Save the chats, phone numbers, payment receipts, screenshots and the listing ID.

step3.title: Report the listing or profile
step3.body: Use the Report button on the listing or on the owner's profile, so we can hide it quickly.

step4.title: Open an urgent ticket
step4.body: Choose <scamTicket>Report a scam</scamTicket> in the help center. These tickets go to the front of the queue.

step5.title: Contact your bank
step5.body: Call your bank or card company right away. They may be able to stop or reverse the payment.

step6.title: Contact the police
step6.body: In Georgia, call <ltr>112</ltr>. You can also report it to the police in your own country.

trust.title: Our promises
trust.lead: What we do so you can trust every listing and every host.

pledge.title: The hosts' pledge
pledge.body: Hosts with the green badge pledged to welcome everyone with respect, without asking about religion or origin.

payOnArrival.title: You pay on arrival
payOnArrival.body: Never pay in advance by link or transfer. You pay the host when you arrive. We take no money.

reportButtons.title: The “Report a scam” button
reportButtons.body: Every listing, the trip page and the booking emails have one button to report. Scam reports are checked before anything else.

verifiedPhones.title: Verified phones
verifiedPhones.body: Every host verifies their phone number with a code before a listing goes live. What the badges mean is below.

realReviews.title: Reviews only from real stays
realReviews.body: A review can only be written after a booking on the site has ended. Nobody edits reviews.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: The exact address is given only to the guest who booked, and hidden again a week after check-out. The map shows only an area.

onlyDomain.title: Our only website
onlyDomain.body: Bayit's only website is {domain}. We will never ask for a payment by link, credit card details or a login code — not by email, SMS or WhatsApp. Seen a copy of Bayit on another address? Tell us on the scam report page.
